left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Diagnosed diabetes mellitus  [AND] and treatment-naïve CI-DME requiring anti-VEGF therapy per retinal specialist's customary treatment regimen will be recruited to participate in the study

right.raw_text: CI-DME will be defined as a central subfield thickness (CST) [OR]  > 300 microns on spectral domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT) or CST  [AND] > 250 microns with definite intra-retinal cystic fluid accumulation

left.raw_text: Additional inclusion criteria are age > 18 years, and ability to give informed consent

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Age < 18 years, inability to give informed consent, evidence of proliferative diabetic retinopathy, evidence of other serious ocular disease (age-related macular degeneration, [OR]  glaucoma, significant media opacity), history of previous intraocular surgery, including macular  [OR] or panretinal photocoagulation (except uncomplicated cataract  [OR] or keratorefractive surgery more than 6 months prior to enrollment), pregnant  [OR] and nursing women, known sensitivity to any of the supplement ingredients
